decision.observation: Confirmed: the woven lattice sphere stands at the east end of this teal cavern — the same cage seen in the loop room, with a curled horned finial at its upper-right and a wooden peg leaning at its lower-left base. Hornet stands just left of it at ~(0.49,0.58), on the stone-tiled path. HUD: one mask cone, 3 pips, short silk bar.
decision.hypothesis: A held (charged) needle strike may behave differently from quick taps against this thick iron lattice; a charged slash at the cage's face is untested.
decision.memory: Cage inert to Up, quick X taps (bright flash only), A. Untested: held/charged X.
